output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.discount_pct > 0), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discounted_revenue_pct
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This is the net amount of lines with a discount (discount_pct > 0) as a percentage of the net amount of all lines. It covers only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue) with an order date in 2025. Revenue here means net line amounts after discounts, so shipping fees are not included.
